results.title: Mother’s Day: 2026 Date, Origin & Traditions | HISTORY
results.content:
The American incarnation of Mother’s Day, held annually on the second Sunday in May, was created by Anna Jarvis in 1908 and became an official U.S. holiday in 1914. Jarvis later denounced the holiday’s commercialization and spent the latter part of her life trying to remove it from the calendar.

## When Is Mother’s Day?

In the United States, Mother’s Day 2026 falls on Sunday, May 10. It has been held on the second Sunday in May since it became a national holiday in 1914. [...] In the United States, Mother’s Day continues to be celebrated by presenting mothers and other women with gifts and flowers, and it has become one of the biggest holidays for consumer spending. Families also celebrate by giving mothers a day off from activities like cooking or other household chores. [...] ## Early Mother’s Day Efforts in the United States

The origins of Mother’s Day as celebrated in the United States date back to the 19th century. In the years before the Civil War, Ann Reeves Jarvis of West Virginia helped start “Mothers’ Day Work Clubs" to teach local women how to properly care for their children.

FAQ

When is Mother’s Day 2026 in the US?

In the US, Mother's Day is on Sunday, May 10, 2026. It always falls on the second Sunday in May.

Why do the US and UK celebrate on different dates?

The UK observes Mothering Sunday, which is tied to the church calendar and always falls on the fourth Sunday in Lent. The US date was established later, rooted in Anna Jarvis’s campaign to designate the second Sunday in May.

Is Mother's Day on the same date every year? [...] ## When is Mother's Day 2026?

In the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, Mother's Day 2026 lands on Sunday, May 10.

However, if you are in the United Kingdom or Ireland, you will celebrate Mothering Sunday a bit earlier on Sunday, March 15. Other nations have their own unique schedules—for instance, France and Sweden will observe the holiday on Sunday, May 31, while Mexico consistently celebrates on May 10 every single year.

## Mother's Day 2026 Dates by Country [...] No. Most countries use a "Sunday rule" (like the second Sunday in May), meaning the exact calendar date shifts every year. However, a few countries have fixed dates, such as Mexico (May 10) and Poland (May 26).

When is Mother's Day in Canada and Australia?

Both Canada and Australia follow the same schedule as the US, celebrating on Sunday, May 10, 2026 (the second Sunday in May).

When is Mother's Day in France?

France observes Fête des mères on Sunday, May 31, 2026.
